treasuryMigration.note: YieldTreasury above is the POST-MIGRATION address. The original is under migratedFrom; its remaining kfUSD was moved across, and what its ledger claimed above its actual balance could not be.
treasuryMigration.reason: userRewardDebt was never initialised when a holder acquired kafUSD, so every holder was entitled to yield that accrued before they arrived - 3,969 kfUSD of entitlement against 71.45 that existed. claimYield subtracted it from the pool unguarded and underflowed, which reached users as PANIC 17 on the Claim button.
